facts.business: SVC Industries Limited is an Indian listed company with equity shares listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange Limited.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters include evaluation of uncertain financial liabilities of Rs. 4,910.07 Lakhs (Rs. 49.10 Crore) towards non-convertible debentures and loans from state financial institutions with recovery petitions pending before Debt Recovery Tribunal, and litigation matters relating to direct tax, indirect tax, claims, and general legal proceedings.

key_risks: Uncertain financial liabilities of Rs. 4,910.07 Lakhs towards non-convertible debentures and loans from state financial institutions with recovery petitions pending before Debt Recovery Tribunal
Ongoing litigations and claims with various authorities and third parties relating to direct tax, indirect tax, claims, and general legal proceedings
Management's inability to make reliable estimate of amount likely to be paid for settlement of financial liabilities
Pending one-time settlement negotiations with lenders including Pradeshiya Industrial & Investment Corporation of U.P. Limited (PICUP)
